title: Collusive Investments in Technological Compatibility: Lessons from U.S. Railroads in the Late 19th Century
eligible_reason: Single common event date. The 1886 gauge change converted the Southern network in two days (abstract); every DiD regression uses post1886 for all routes, interacted with mode (rail lines aclpal/acl/pal vs steamship) and distance (areg ln_lbs aclpal1_post aclpal1_post_dist ..., absorb(route | route_mode | route_yr) cluster(route)). One adoption cohort; distance interactions are continuous intensity terms. Remaining tables are annual estimates, stock-price event studies (CAR-type reg ret mkt_ret) and model calibration.
design_notes: Stata areg. Route-mode-year freight data (srsa_main.dta), freight rates, stock prices. Tables 3-6 and Figures 2 and 4 from regs_mainresults.do, regs_annualests.do, regs_stockprices.do.
data_files_note: Historical freight-traffic and stock-price datasets shipped.
screener_notes: Abstract from OpenAlex frame; no article text.
